title: Netlify MCP Server
summary: Netlify's official MCP server, started with npx, lets your agent create, configure and deploy sites and manage environment variables.
description: Netlify's MCP server wraps the Netlify API and CLI. An agent can create a project, deploy it, manage environment variables and secrets, turn on form handling and look up team details.

It runs locally with npx and needs Node.js 22 or later. It normally uses your existing Netlify login. A personal access token can be set as an environment variable only to troubleshoot authentication.
useWhen: Deploy a static site from a folder you just built
Add an environment variable to a site
Enable form submissions on a landing page
Check which team a site belongs to

mcp.name: netlify
access: Netlify sites, environment variables and extensions on your account
Can deploy sites and change access controls

example.prompt: Create a new Netlify site from the dist folder and set API_URL to https://api.example.com.
example.result: Created site acme-landing, deployed dist, and set API_URL for all deploy contexts. The live URL is acme-landing.netlify.app.

faq.question: Which Node version do I need?
faq.answer: Node.js 22 or newer, per the project's prerequisites.

faq.question: Do I have to create a token?
faq.answer: Not normally. The token variable NETLIFY_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN is documented only as a troubleshooting step; never commit it.

access: Reads and changes Netlify sites and settings on your account
